meta.title: Latin & Caribbean Soul — Hilton For the Stay | CALA Group Offer
meta.description: Where group travel becomes unforgettable. A group offer across CALA — culture, flavor and celebration with a 5% credit and curated experiences.

hero.subtitle: Latin & Caribbean Soul · Culture. Flavor. Celebration.
hero.intro: Today's group planners are looking for more than room blocks and rates — they want memorable experiences, operational simplicity, and added value that helps them deliver exceptional programs.

offer.title: 5% Credit
offer.lead: A flexible, value-added benefit calculated on net room revenue, designed to enhance the guest experience through curated resort activities and experiences.
offer.body: Combined with exclusive group benefits, it helps planners create richer programs while delivering greater value for every stay.

benefits.title: Elevate every program
benefits.subtitle: Authentic experiences. Memorable moments. One region full of possibilities.

items.title: Experience Credit
items.body: A fixed credit redeemable on qualifying resort experiences, helping guests enjoy more of the destination.

items.title: VIP Amenities
items.body: One VIP welcome amenity for every 15 paid rooms.

items.title: Complimentary Upgrades
items.body: One confirmed room upgrade for every 10 paid rooms, subject to availability.

items.title: Seamless Arrivals
items.body: Dedicated group check-in or pre-arrival key preparation for a smoother guest experience.

items.title: Experience Enhancements
items.body: Choose one exclusive group benefit: a themed cocktail reception with hors d'oeuvres and house wine, or a late check-out day-use option for departure day.

perfectFor.title: Built for every kind of group

concepts.title: Bring the spirit of the region to life
concepts.subtitle: Immersive group experiences inspired by Latin America and the Caribbean's culture, flavor and celebration.

why.title: Value for you. Magic for your clients.
client: Memorable experiences that help sell the destination

contact.title: Let's design your next unforgettable group program
contact.body: Designed to help you win more group business while delivering unforgettable guest experiences. Tell us about your group and we'll prepare a tailored proposal.
